data.narrative:
Reflection AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech peers (including Together AI, Physical Intelligence, and Black Forest Labs) plus 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression anchors to the last post-money of $25.0B and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $50.0B. Peer-median triangulation uses three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $3.2B (Black Forest Labs) to $8.3B (Together AI), producing a median of $5.6B. The stark divergence between methods reflects tension between the company's current funding-round valuation and early-stage peer trading ranges.

Triangulation across both methods produces a range of $4.8B (low) to $57.5B (high), with a median of $27.8B. The wide band reflects two competing signals: the stage-progression method anchored to recent fundraising activity, and peer-median indicating substantial overvaluation relative to comparable early-stage AI companies. Key uncertainties include whether the $25.0B post-money represents a sustainable entry point versus a spike driven by market exuberance, and whether Reflection AI's specific capabilities justify a valuation premium over the peer set. Material downside risk exists if subsequent fundraising normalizes toward peer multiples.
